comparison.objective: Build a stable 3-2-1 pyramid from six cans.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated precise placement and bridging on progressively less stable supports.
comparison.success_condition: Six upright, resting cans form the specified three tiers; tipping or single-can tower shortcuts invalidate credit.
comparison.reason: Stable stacking tests placement and support geometry, with no mechanism adjustment, tool reacquisition, or dynamic commissioning.
